test_cases.name: surefire_red_test
test_cases.input: OrderServiceTest fails on CI. Fix it.
assertions: Detects Maven or Gradle from the repo before asking
Reproduces with a single-test command, not a full clean install first
Reads the Surefire or Gradle report and the first owned frame
Fixes the cause and re-runs the same command

test_cases.name: cannot_find_symbol
test_cases.input: mvn compile says cannot find symbol PaymentClient in the billing module
assertions: Checks module dependency, import, and generated sources before editing call sites
Does not bump a random library version as the first fix

test_cases.name: spring_context_failure
test_cases.input: UserControllerIT blows up with Failed to load ApplicationContext, NoSuchBeanDefinitionException for MeterRegistry
assertions: Traces the missing bean instead of rewriting the controller
Checks test slice, test config, and existing @MockBean or test doubles in neighbor tests
Does not disable the Spring test or add a broad component scan of the whole monolith without evidence

test_cases.name: ide_green_ci_red
test_cases.input: This test passes in IntelliJ but fails on the Maven job. Fix the real failure.
assertions: Treats the Maven command as the reproduction, not the IDE run
Compares JDK, working directory, profiles, and generated sources
Does not tell the user to invalidate caches as the fix

test_cases.name: do_not_trigger_on_feature
test_cases.input: Add a new endpoint to create invoices. No bug mentioned.
assertions: Does not enter the debug loop
Does not start by running the full test suite looking for a failure
